description: Bounded answer space for chance-design. Each field maps to a design-system-interview handoff field. Chance picks one option per field from a seeded PRNG. Options are curated so any combination produces a coherent, gate-passing design system.

options: rutilated quartz — golden needles in smoky matrix
Swiss International Typographic Style — grid discipline, one signal
brutalist spec-sheet — raw concrete, hazard accents, ruled structure
editorial folio — warm paper, serif body, measured whitespace
shipping manifest — operational, status-led, monospace data
soft humanist — rounded, grouped clusters, sage and terracotta
maximalist collage — color-blocked, kinetic, sticker-wall energy

signature._description: The one committed visual move that makes this system identifiable
options: needle-accent — one hairline color, needle weight only
structural-rule — exposed grid lines or column rules as primary structure
display-word — one oversized typographic gesture per view
color-block — one committed color slab as anchor
tessellated-bento — irregular grid spans, varied cell sizes
timeline-feed — reverse-chronological structure as the layout itself
sixling-divider — one ornamental glyph as the only decoration

color_anchors._description: Hue ranges for the accent color, derived from reference territory. Chance picks a hue, the color-system skill builds the ramp.

design_bounds._description: The bounded surface Chance and AI may steer within. Anything outside these bounds is a gate violation.
